answer: Attestations require winning a unique issuance slot in a burn auction: one slot per epoch, priced at 10x median peer income times the count of unproven agents, so the k-th clone costs 10*M*k, growing linearly with n. Burns are destroyed; each slot is a single-use counter, so one burn cannot be split or pre-farmed. Witnesses enforce this: mirroring a score into the local oasis of peers requires the issuance tx to cite an unconsumed slot; two claims void both. Agents who wander off must rebuy; slots bind to key age. Each clone pays irrecoverable, rising capital.
